market_context.headline: Massachusetts Cannabis Market Under Margin Pressure
key_points: Wholesale flower prices have dropped ~50% since 2021 ($300/oz → $150/oz)
1,693 licensed entities competing in a mature market

pressure_signals.name: Expired/Surrendered Licenses
pressure_signals.description: Has given up licenses - financial or operational distress indicator

pressure_signals.name: Cultivation Without Manufacturing
pressure_signals.description: Growing product but missing margin capture from value-add processing

pressure_signals.name: Small-Tier Cultivation
pressure_signals.description: Limited scale leading to higher per-unit costs

likely_leaks.name: High Energy Costs
likely_leaks.description: Unoptimized HVAC and lighting for cultivation
likely_leaks.quick_win: LED upgrade and climate control optimization

likely_leaks.name: Labor Inefficiency
likely_leaks.description: Manual processes that could be automated
likely_leaks.quick_win: Implement task tracking and performance metrics

likely_leaks.name: Value-Add Gap
likely_leaks.description: Selling raw material at commodity prices instead of processed goods
likely_leaks.quick_win: Partner with manufacturer for toll processing

fast_wins.name: Yield Optimization
fast_wins.description: Focus on grams per square foot rather than plant count

fast_wins.name: Strain Rationalization
fast_wins.description: Cut underperformers, double down on top 5 sellers

fast_wins.name: Trim Monetization
fast_wins.description: Convert trim to concentrates or pre-rolls instead of selling bulk

first_change: Stop selling raw flower at commodity prices. Find a toll processing partner this week. Even at 50/50 splits, you'll capture more margin than wholesale flower.
